releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.89 removes Home weather, temperature and Home location requests completely while keeping the greeting, date and live Bahrain time. Internal pages gain a Home action that returns directly to the root without changing existing Back/X behavior. Price Book product images are about 12% larger and remain uncropped, while v0.11.88 Guide/Child, Paste Link, product actions and existing local data are preserved.
